purpose: Teach: 創っ/寄贈/自費/元本/学業/委ねる/備品/持ち歩い

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 企業を創った創業者の言葉、忘れるな。
lines.en: Don't forget the words of the founder who built this company.
lines.style: Slow, measured delivery. Weight on each phrase. Not lecturing — passing down. Gaze steady, as if looking both backward and forward in time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。地域に貢献するため、施設を寄贈しました。
lines.en: Yes. To serve the community, we donated those facilities.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Clear, direct answer without filler. Slight nod in the voice. Shows understanding has taken root, not just heard.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃は、自費で学会、参加したな。
lines.en: In my younger days, I paid my own way to every conference I could attend.
lines.style: Gentle nostalgia. Slight warmth on the memory. Not boasting — illustrating. Pace unhurried, as if seeing it again. Trailing off softly at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。元本を守る経営、引き継いでいます。
lines.en: Yes. I'm continuing that same principle-first management approach he established.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Respectful, almost formal register. The voice of someone carrying something forward with care. Steady tempo, no rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 学業出身の若手、伸ばす責任、リーダーにある。
lines.en: Young people with academic backgrounds — it's a leader's responsibility to help them grow.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. This is a principle, stated plainly. Slight emphasis on 「責任」 in the voice. The tone of someone who has carried this weight and accepted it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実務、信頼する後輩に、委ねるようにしていきます。
lines.en: I'm working toward delegating more operations to the junior staff I trust.
lines.style: Measured and thoughtful. Not hesitant — deliberate. Shows movement toward action. Slight nod of agreement with himself. Warm but professional register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 備品の節約も、現場の文化として大切だ。
lines.en: Equipment conservation — that's also part of the culture we build in the field.
lines.style: Calm emphasis on the practical. Not pedantic. The voice of someone who sees small habits as the bedrock of bigger values. Steady, unhurried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。判断材料、いつも持ち歩いています。
lines.en: Yes. I always keep the information I need to make sound decisions with me.
lines.style: Quiet resolution. The closing statement of someone ready. Slight warmth — not cold, but composed. Breath settled. End clean, without trailing off.
